Convert edge data frame to igraph

Source: R/converters.R
to_igraph.Rd

to_igraph() converts a bibnets edge list to an igraph graph with igraph::graph_from_data_frame(). It requires the suggested package igraph. For a tbl_graph use to_tbl_graph(); for a cograph network use to_cograph().

Usage

to_igraph(edges, directed = FALSE)

Arguments

edges

A data frame with at least from, to, weight columns, as returned by any network function in bibnets.

directed

Logical. Default FALSE.

Value

An igraph graph with one vertex per node label and one edge per row of edges; the remaining columns (weight, count, ...) become edge attributes.

Examples

data(biblio_data)
edges <- author_network(biblio_data, "collaboration")
to_igraph(edges)
#> IGRAPH 5dc2c8f UNW- 6 12 -- 
#> + attr: name (v/c), weight (e/n), count (e/n)
#> + edges from 5dc2c8f (vertex names):
#>  [1] CHEN W --LEE K   BROWN M--SMITH J BROWN M--LEE K   JONES A--LEE K  
#>  [5] JONES A--SMITH J LEE K  --SMITH J CHEN W --BROWN M BROWN M--DAVIS R
#>  [9] CHEN W --DAVIS R CHEN W --JONES A JONES A--DAVIS R DAVIS R--SMITH J
